_comment: Copy this file to live-config.json and edit values to control the app centrally.
_comment2: All fields are optional. Remove any field to use the built-in default.

theme._comment: Override CSS accent colours. Any valid CSS color string.

introHub._comment: Remote background image for the Home Hub screen.
introHub.headline: QuickTap Race Week — All challenges this week are QuickTap!

music._comment: Remote music track URLs (must be http:// or https://).

mainTv._comment: Headline shown in the main game TV viewport when no live event is active.
mainTv.headline: QuickTap Race Week 🏃 Every challenge this week is QuickTap Race!

challenge._comment: weeklyMode overrides the player's comp-selection setting for the week.
challenge._comment2: Accepted values: random-games, single-game, user-selection, arcade-only, trivia-only, endurance-only, logic-only, retired, misc, unique
challenge._comment3: weeklyGameKeys is used when weeklyMode is user-selection

players._comment: Override an AI houseguest's avatar and profile text.
players.name: Finn
players.bio: Returning champion — now playing for redemption.
